project: Wuxia Life P129 Ordinary-Origin Early Visible Growth Sample
description: Single-sample follow-up to P128: extend early visible growth proof from vivid origins (merchant/martial) to one ordinary origin (tavern_hand) using socialMomentum on existing summary, feedback, settlement, and continuation surfaces. No multi-origin Wave 4 expansion, no scholar work, no new growth system.

userStories.title: Lock tavern_hand sample scope and habit axis directness
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want P129 scope locked to tavern_hand plus socialMomentum before implementation, so the stage does not sprawl into multi-origin Wave 4 expansion or indirect studyHabit chains.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix sample origin to tavern_hand only; no farm_peasant or town_apprentice parallel work (PRD section 4 Out of Scope)
Fix shaping axis to socialMomentum only; verify direct path via p9_echo_social_hook mapping in ActivePlanningService (PRD section 3.2)
Primary action is action_socializing_lite; primary sample band ages 5-8; continuation band ages 8-13
Continuation targets limited to p9_echo_social_hook, p9_early_social_focus, ordinary_tavern_network_fork, and P28 socialMomentum events for readability only
Do not add new growth containers, panels, route families, or cross-origin template abstractions
Do not respawn P122, P127, or P128 closed work
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Scope lock first. Habit directness pre-verified in P128 discovery gaps report.

userStories.title: Show socialMomentum shaping confirmation on summary surfaces
userStories.description: As a player on tavern_hand, I want the main screen to clearly show that repeated early socializing is shaping me, so ordinary childhood feels like growth instead of passive replay.
acceptanceCriteria: On the tavern_hand 5-8 sample path, shapingSummary transitions from 塑形未成 to 人情 · 渐成 when socialMomentum threshold is met (PRD section 6 Signal A, US-002)
Confirmation text comes from existing socialMomentum/lifeStates wiring, not a new parallel growth system
Copy expresses social shaping direction rather than repeating origin flavor such as 你出身酒肆
Reuse existing MainScreenLifeSummary / shapingSummary surfaces only; no new UI panel
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Equivalent to P122/P127 summary-surface proof, but for socialMomentum on ordinary origin.

userStories.title: Show long-term impact after early socializing actions
userStories.description: As a player, I want early socializing actions to leave visible long-term traces in the feedback area, so I can connect my behavior to social shaping.
acceptanceCriteria: After sample early action_socializing_lite actions, feedback area shows at least one player-visible long-term impact confirmation (PRD section 6 Signal C, US-003)
Confirmation reads as this will continue to affect my life direction, not only charisma/connections stat deltas
Reuse existing long-term impact / flag display mechanism; no new feedback framework
Does not open a new branch at this step; causal visibility only
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add period settlement social shaping summary
userStories.description: As a player, I want age progression to tell me what social shaping line became clearer this period, so each age step feels like meaningful growth.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one age progression / period settlement on the tavern_hand sample path summarizes shaping change via existing periodSummaryDisplay (PRD section 6 Signal B, US-004)
Settlement copy answers what kind of social person you are becoming this period, not only generic narrative or stat fragments
Summary correlates with prior socializing behavior, not passive age-based growth
Reuse the existing settlement surface; do not add an independent settlement system
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Settlement confirmation required; otherwise slice stays event-local.

userStories.title: Prove tavern childhood fork continuation readability
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want bounded proof that visible social shaping makes tavern childhood fork continuation easier to read, so P129 demonstrates reuse beyond the first confirmation moment.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce bounded proof for tavern_hand ages 5-13 only
Evidence shows behavior -> socialMomentum accumulation -> visible confirmation -> ordinary_tavern_network_fork and/or P28 socialMomentum event becoming more readable as continuation
At least two different player-visible confirmation signals present across summary / feedback / settlement surfaces
Do not expand P59 merchant bridge, P71 renown bridge, or Wave 4 multi-origin midlife content in this stage
Save proof as docs/test-reports/p129-ordinary-origin-visible-growth-sample-proof.md
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Real stage goal: prove visible-growth pattern works on ordinary origin with direct socialMomentum axis.

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage for ordinary-origin visible growth
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow automated tests guarding the tavern_hand visible-growth loop so future edits do not silently revert the player-facing confirmation pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update a narrow test file covering the tavern_hand visible-growth loop (e.g. tests/p129OrdinaryOriginVisibleGrowthTests.ts)
Cover shapingSummary confirmation on the tavern_hand sample path
Cover long-term impact visibility after early socializing actions
Cover periodSummaryDisplay shaping summary tied to socializing behavior
Cover at least one continuation-readability check for ordinary_tavern_network_fork or P28 socialMomentum event
Include scope guards: tavern_hand only, socialMomentum only, no multi-origin expansion
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Reuse narrow test style from P122/P127. Do not build generic cross-origin framework.
